The Evidence and Structure pages now have a **Spread** slider and ways to fly through the 3D view. The slider and zooming work in the browser; flying and the reset button still need you to try them.

I checked with the two other sessions first. Neither was touching these files, and their notes on how to avoid conflicts are followed. I've told them I'm finished.

**Spread slider (bottom centre, 1× to 4×)**
- It pushes everything further apart, while the dots, halos, diamonds and labels grow only a little. So the gaps open up instead of everything just getting bigger.
- The camera pulls back with it, so the view stays framed. You then zoom into the area you want.
- On Structure at 3.1×, clusters separated clearly and far fewer theme labels were hidden by overlaps.
- Your chosen spread is remembered in your browser.

**Why zooming sometimes didn't work, and the fix**
- Zoom always aimed at the centre of the universe and stopped 2.2 units from it, so you couldn't get any closer.
- Now the scroll wheel zooms toward whatever is under your mouse and can go much closer. This also works with the pointer over a label.

**Moving back and forth**
- **W / S** flies forward and back, **A / D** moves sideways, and **Q / E** moves down and up. Hold **Shift** to go faster. The arrow keys still switch checkpoints.
- Right-drag (or Shift-drag) pans the view.
- The pad has hold-to-fly forward/back buttons and a **Reset view** button that glides back to the starting view.

**Checked so far:** the type-check passes. In the browser, the slider, zoom-toward-cursor and zoom over labels all worked.
